title: A Joomla import names an old PHP when phpinfo is disabled
steps: Run installCowork against a fake Joomla whose phpinfo page is blank and whose System Information JSON names PHP 7.3.33.
Run it against one whose package installer refuses PHP 7.3.33.
expect: php_too_old with php 7.3.33, before any install POST.
php_too_old with php 7.3.33 and minimum 7.4.0 (check installer_php_floor), not install_failed.

tests: the package installer refusing the site
